notes.title: Zigglox is out!
notes.content:
Thank you for supporting us since the beginning!

We're going to continue working on Zigglox, and Etienne and I are already discussing a possible local version, and perhaps console versions (Switch, PlayStation and Xbox).

The next update will fix a few minor bugs, plus a few improvements.

Have fun playing Zigglox!

[previewyoutube=g4_uGhqeYbA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Zigglox
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281805/40a6e7a48443a23d21c11bbdef6003a9e93ce38f.png[/img]

Zigglox is a multiplayer online game that plays from 4 to players (in a 2V2, 3V3, 4V4 format) confronting a team versus another - You can finally get rid of your friends.

This demo is the last one before the official release of the game, so please try it out before it stops !

notes.title: Zigglox
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281805/40a6e7a48443a23d21c11bbdef6003a9e93ce38f.png[/img]

Find and craft the best possible bricks and stack them to build the tallest and the prettier tower before the other team!

Zigglox is a multiplayer online game that plays from 4 to 8 players (in a 2V2, 3V3, 4V4 format) confronting a team versus another - You can finally get rid of your friends.

This demo is the last one before the official release of the game, so please try it out before it stops !

notes.title: Zigglox demo is out!
notes.content:
After more than a year working on Zigglox, our demo is finally out, and playable for free on Steam!
Let's gooo : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1514880/Zigglox/
Feel free to give us some feedback, and have fun! 🙂

notes.title: Zigglox - Demo available on Steam soon!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=qTc-ubTRWb8;full][/previewyoutube]

[u]For this demo we've ended up with this configuration:[/u]

[b]3 maps:[/b]
    - Potamia Ruins
    - Big Bigorno Beach
    - Bouloboley Forest

[b]9 skins [/b](or is it 10? I can't remember...)

This demo will be updated to fix reported bugs, and will be maintained until the official game release date will be announced
We've made up a Feedback button right on the menu screen, so you can share your thoughts about the game with us 🙂

[b]Again, thank you being part of this demo, this is a new (and great !) adventure for us![/b]

Jeremy & Etienne
